thread:
Ava (PM): Quick review please  new 'welcome strip' for empty projects. Intention: surface curated sample projects + compact quickstart CTA without pushing a modal. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/welcome-strip. Need sign-off on layout, copy, and a11y before I put it on QA.

Sam (Designer): Two directions: Tile stack (single column card, small art) vs. Mosaic (two-column grid with wider artwork). Mosaic looks friendlier but might be heavy on mobile. Added annotations in the file.

Noor (Frontend): I can build both. Two concerns: images should lazy-load and be low-res placeholders; animation budget  prefer CSS transitions only. Also need the analytics event names.

Ava (PM): Use CSS only. Analytics: `onboarding_welcome_impression`, `onboarding_welcome_cta_click`, `onboarding_welcome_dismiss`. Mobile behavior: single stacked card, no auto-advance.

Sam (Designer): Copy options: Headline: "Get started with a sample project" / "Start with a demo" / "Launch a sample". Primary CTA: "Open sample" Secondary: "See templates" Helper: "Get a working app in minutes"

Sasha (A11y): A11y checklist: ensure contrast ratio >= 4.5 for body text against bg; focus visible for CTA (4px focus ring is okay if offset); images need descriptive alt text from API; any live region should be `aria-live="polite"` and only update on user action not on timer. Also respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.

Noor (Frontend): For focus I'll use `box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--focus)` on :focus-visible with 3px offset. Will wire alt text from `sample.title` and fallback to `template`. For live region, we won't use auto-rotate.

Rafi (DevOps): Backend: will serve sample list from `/api/v1/sample-projects?env=prod` with a `curated` boolean. For dismissal persistence: server flag for logged-in users, cookie/localStorage for anonymous. TTL 45 days?

Ava (PM): Let's do 30 days for parity with other onboarding nudges. Add `dismiss_reason` dimension (`x_click`, `completed`, `skip`).

Sam (Designer): Microcopy tweak: prefer headline "Start with a demo"  shorter and matches CTAs. Suggest we A/B headline variants.

Sasha (A11y): Also recommend ensuring minimum touch target 44px and that color tokens used for CTAs meet contrast when used on alt backgrounds. If helper text is small, bump weight to 600.

Noor (Frontend): Quick prototype CSS I used: ```css
.welcome-strip{display:flex;gap:12px;padding:16px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--panel)}
.welcome-cta{padding:10px 16px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--accent);color:#fff;transition:transform 90ms}
.welcome-cta:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
@media(max-width:600px){.welcome-strip{flex-direction:column}}
```
No animation beyond hover. Will add `@media (prefers-reduced-motion)` override.

Rafi (DevOps): For experiments I'll create a LaunchDarkly toggle `welcome_strip_variant` with `control,tiles,mosaic`. Start with 8% rollout. Will also emit events to analytics pipeline.

OnboardingBot: Experiment "welcome-strip-mar2026" created by Ava. Feature flag: welcome_strip_variant. Audience: 8% sample.

Ava (PM): Good. Metrics: `welcome_click_rate`, `created_from_sample_within_7d`. Keep A/B window 2 weeks.

Sam (Designer): I'll add micro visual variants and small gif prototypes into the figma comments to clarify interactions.

Sasha (A11y): I'll run a pre-merge checklist once Noor has a demo branch. Will test keyboard nav, screen reader announcements, alt text presence.

Noor (Frontend): I'll push a demo branch by EOD with both tile and mosaic implementations behind the LD flag. Will add unit tests for keyboard focus.

Rafi (DevOps): I'll hook up the flag and ensure server-sent sample list has `alt_text` and `curated` fields. Also will implement server-side dismissal store.

Ava (PM): Thanks team  action items: Noor demo branch + accessibility knobs, Sasha to verify a11y, Rafi to add LD flag + API fields, Sam to finalize microcopy. QA scheduled Thu. :v:
